title: Steam platform
summary: The process's connection to Steam behind a pure C header: start with an optional restart through Steam, a per-frame pump with manual callback dispatch, typed events the game pulls, stop; and a net-link transport on Steam's networking sockets in IP mode (two windows on one PC, a LAN). Builds without the Steamworks SDK and runs without a Steam client, both as silent solo.
dependencies: Steamworks SDK through STEAMWORKS_SDK_DIR (optional, outside git; only redistributable_bin ships)
features/net-link for the steam_net_link target (optional; added before this feature)
provides: steam_platform_start / steam_platform_stop / steam_platform_ready: one connection per process, statuses READY, NO_SDK, NO_CLIENT, RESTARTING, FAILED
steam_platform_run_frame / steam_platform_next_event: manual dispatch into a fixed event queue (OVERLAY)
steam_platform_deploy(<target> [APP_ID <id>]): the runtime library beside an executable, a development steam_appid.txt with APP_ID, its removal without

steam_net_link_host_ip / steam_net_link_join_ip: net_link_t over ISteamNetworkingSockets in IP mode, NULL without the SDK or Steam; steam_net_link_lingering: the shutdown wait before steam_platform_stop; steam_net_link_set_fake: Steam's process-wide fake network
src/steam_platform_internal.h: raw callbacks by id, awaited and cancelled call results, frame and stopping hooks, counters and test hooks for the feature's own targets
